description: Get the current UK national electricity generation mix by fuel source from the National Grid ESO. Returns the percentage contribution of each fuel type: biomass, coal, imports, gas, nuclear, other, hydro, solar, and wind. Data is updated every 30 minutes. Useful for understanding real-time renewable vs fossil fuel share, carbon-aware computing, and energy transition analysis. CC BY 4.0, no upstream cost.
